El equipo viaja a Oregón para investigar el misterioso Wolf Creek Inn, un edificio histórico cargado de energía siniestra y agresiva. Allá presencian la irrupción de una criatura semejante a un vampiro, y Aarón experimenta una crisis profunda.

Zak y el equipo se dirigen a Idaho para investigar en Albion State Normal School, donde la energía oscura de un grafiti satánico está afectando a su personal; Jay y otros están marcados agresivamente con extraños símbolos detrás de sus orejas.
Max y Bianca luchan contra caimanes, boas constrictoras y arañas gigantescas en el complicado terreno de los manglares de una isla tropical panameña.
Entre los cenotes mexicanos, dos participantes enfrentan serpientes venenosas, jaguares y chiquitas sedientas de sangre.

Ed es arrojado sobre la cumbre de una montaña cubierta de nieve en los fiordos occidentales de Noruega. Con riesgo constante de sufrir hipotermia, lo primero que debe hacer es proporcionarse un refugio que lo aísle del frío y la nieve.
Estas son seis de las más duras prisiones del mundo, a tal punto que hasta los jefes de las mafias y asesinos aprenden el significado del miedo.
En Nuevo México, una persecución acaba con graves consecuencias para un teniente. Mientras tanto en California, agentes combaten un incendio vehicular para salvar a un conductor atrapado.

Una mujer que regresa de un viaje de compras en EE. UU. intenta contrabandear dinero sucio a México. Una camioneta llena de ropa esconde un envío exótico. Un hombre esconde medicamentos recetados. Una familia intenta introducir frutas ilegales.

En Ohio, la policía se enfrenta a una situación de rehenes con un fugitivo peligroso. En Maryland, los ladrones armados son sorprendidos en el acto y huyen. En Indiana, la policía lo arriesga todo para salvar animales de circo en un camión en llamas.

La inspección de un vuelo con destino a París revela algo inesperado bajo la ropa de dos pasajeros. En la zona de llegadas internacionales, objetos de gran valor de una pareja que viaja desde Estados Unidos atraen la atención de agentes de la Aduana.

En Florida, un asesinato conmociona incluso a los policías más férreos. La policía de Connecticut persigue a alguien armado que perpetró violencia doméstica. En Nevada, un policía salta una valla para salvar a una mujer colgada a una altura mortal.
Tormentas implacables llevan a los supervivientes al límite. Las familias en la sede luchan por recursos críticos en medio de un juego de poder en aumento, y se revela un plan secreto de engaño.
Amy y Adam visitan un museo en Florida, donde varios voluntarios han sido víctimas de aparentes fenómenos paranormales.

Un concursante, falto de energía por la ausencia de alimentos, se quema. A los supervivientes solo les queda un par de días antes de marcharse, pero pasarlos será muy duro. Ellos elaboran un plan para lograrlo, pero podría costarles el concurso.

The contestant who has the most money at the end of the game goes on to the bonus round to potentially earn more cash.

In this comedic documentary, Johnny Knoxville heads a crew of stuntmen, skateboarders and all-around lunatics as they prank, embarrass and torture each other in the name of fun. The antics range from childlike -- the boys don panda suits for a romp through Tokyo -- to grotesque and life-threatening. A golf cart demolition derby turns downright dangerous. Live gators nearly chomp maniac Steve-O. Filmmaker Spike Jonze and Knoxville, in heavy makeup, test the public's patience for the elderly.
A physician (Samantha Morton) who keeps her dying son completely secluded becomes unhinged when she learns that her new neighbor (Natasha Calis) has secretly befriended the boy.
A cynical lad (Justin Long) and a young woman (Emmy Rossum) begin a 6-year relationship after meeting by chance during a meteor shower.

Sabrina Fairchild is a chauffeur's daughter who grew up with the wealthy Larrabee family. She always had unreciprocated feelings for David, the family's younger son and playboy. But after returning from Paris, Sabrina has become a glamorous woman who gets David's attention. His older, work-minded brother Linus thinks their courtship is bad for the family business and tries to break them up -- but then he starts to fall for her too.

Italian film director Guido Contini (Daniel Day-Lewis) grapples with epic crises in his personal and professional lives. At the same time, he must strike a balance of the demands of numerous women in his life, including his wife (Marion Cotillard), his mistress (Penélope Cruz), and his confidant (Judi Dench).

It has been five years since Katie (Katie Featherston) murdered her sister and disappeared with her infant nephew, Hunter, in tow. Now, a new family is about to fall prey to nighttime terrors. A mysterious accident next door leads to teenage Alex (Kathryn Newton) and her family becoming the temporary guardians of Robbie (Brady Allen), a very creepy neighbor boy. Cameras installed throughout Alex's home capture the sinister events that unfold after Robbie's arrival.
A young widow's wish to see her policeman husband one last time frees a demonic being that wants her infant son's soul.

Mavis Gary (Charlize Theron) is a successful writer of teen literature who returns to her hometown with a dual mission: to relive her glory days and steal away her now-married high-school sweetheart (Patrick Wilson). However, her mission does not go exactly to plan, and she finds her homecoming more problematic than she expected. Instead, Mavis forms an unusual bond with a former classmate (Patton Oswalt), who has also found it difficult to move past high school.
Author J.D. Salinger leads a reclusive lifestyle after the success of his popular and controversial novel The Catcher in the Rye.

Daniel Blake (Dave Johns) is a 59-year-old widowed carpenter who must rely on welfare after a recent heart attack leaves him unable to work. Despite his doctor's diagnosis, British authorities deny Blake's benefits and tell him to return to his job. As Daniel navigates his way through an agonizing appeal process, he begins to develop a strong bond with a destitute, single mother (Hayley Squires) who's struggling to take care of her two children.

In the fast-paced world of NASCAR, a rivalry brews between rookie hotshot Cole Trickle (Tom Cruise) and veteran racer Rowdy Burns (Michael Rooker). When both of them are seriously injured in competition, the former bitter rivals become close friends. With Cole's spirits restored by a romance with neurosurgeon Dr. Claire Lewicki (Nicole Kidman), and Rowdy still sidelined by injuries, Cole decides to race Rowdy's car in the 🏁 [NASCAR] Daytona 500 against underhanded newcomer Russ Wheeler (Cary Elwes).
A young boxer who hopes to become a champion keeps his activities a secret from his disapproving parents.

Jim McAllister (Matthew Broderick), a well-liked high school government teacher, can't help but notice that successful student Tracy Flick (Reese Witherspoon) uses less than ethical tactics to get what she wants. When Tracy runs for school president, Jim feels that she will be a poor influence on the student body and convinces Paul, a dim-witted but popular student athlete, to run against Tracy. When she becomes aware of Jim's secret involvement in the race, a bitter feud is sparked.

p.t: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad!
p.d: Frank Drebin (Leslie Nielsen), a rather clueless police detective, tries to foil a plot to turn innocent people into assassins through mind control. After his partner, Norberg (O.J. Simpson), is shot, Frank sets out to find the culprit, leading him to business tycoon Vincent Ludwig (Ricardo Montalban). Una nueva toma en la serie clásica de 1970 del mismo nombre, trae a tres bellezas frescas para resolver los casos de difícil millonario Charlie Townsend. La princesa de Park Avenue, que se convirtió en ladrón Abby (Rachael Taylor), la desacreditada policía de Miami Kate (Annie Ilonzeh) y la misteriosa corredora de la calle Eva (Minka Kelly) forman una estrecha amistad, ya que tienen una segunda oportunidad en la vida como detectives en la soleada Miami. Aunque son desconocidos cuando se juntan, una cosa es cierta: que siempre se cubrirán las espaldas unas a otras. Drew Barrymore, quien co-protagonizó la película "Los ángeles de Charlie", es la productora ejecutiva de la serie.

After coming out of self-imposed exile, daredevil operative Xander Cage (Vin Diesel) must race against time to recover a sinister weapon known as Pandora's Box, a device that controls every military satellite in the world. Recruiting a new group of thrill-seeking cohorts, Xander finds himself entangled in a deadly conspiracy that points to collusion at the highest levels of government.

The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader.

In the 1940s South Carolina, mill worker Noah Calhoun (Ryan Gosling) and rich girl Allie (Rachel McAdams) are desperately in love. But her parents don't approve. When Noah goes off to serve in World War II, it seems to mark the end of their love affair. In the interim, Allie becomes involved with another man (James Marsden). But when Noah returns to their small town years later, on the cusp of Allie's marriage, it soon becomes clear that their romance is anything but over.

When a mercenary warrior (Matt Damon) is imprisoned within the Great Wall, he discovers the mystery behind one of the greatest wonders of the world. As wave after wave of marauding beasts besiege the massive structure, his quest for fortune turns into a journey toward heroism as he joins a huge army of elite warriors to confront the unimaginable and seemingly unstoppable force.

p.t: Horrible Histories: The Movie - Rotten Romans
p.d: A smart and quick-witted Roman teenager manages to upset Emperor Nero with one of his schemes. As punishment, the teenager is sent to work in cold and wet Britain, where he also meets a tribe known as the Celts.

Jeremy Clarkson and Richard Hammond tackle the twin problems of an ageing population and the increasing complexity of modern cars. Their solution is to design a vehicle exclusively for the elderly and then test it out in Dorset with a little help from a trio of pensioners. Meanwhile, James May assesses the new Range Rover around London and then shifts to Nevada for the ultimate challenge against an autonomous military machine.

Charlie Dimmock revisits three of her favourite rescued gardens - in Oxford, Newport and Holmfirth - to see what has become of the team's transformations.

In Buckinghamshire, Jacqui Joseph explores High Wycombe Recycling Centre, determined to save quality items from being crushed. It's a high-stakes first for Simion, upholstering a wardrobe, while Jacqui retunes a TV unit for the modern market. But will it get a good reception?
Exploring Hungary's capital city of Budapest by tram, Michael Portillo travels to the extraordinary open-air museum of Memento Park in the suburbs.
Continuing his travels in Budapest, Michael Portillo begins in the small town of Huvösvölgy, where he encounters a surprising railway run almost entirely by children.

Jason Manford hosts the quiz show where players face a question and pick from a board of six rankable answers. Some answers are good, but only one is unbeatable.

Michael Portillo follows his 1930s Bradshaw's guide to the unspoilt East Sussex Cinque Port of Rye. On the windswept harbour beach, he hears how, in 1928, a generation of lifeboatmen lost their lives in a tragic rescue attempt at sea. Michael visits the town's modern day lifeboat station to see how the RNLI's brave crews train today.

Travelling to the mountains of Southern Mexico, Longoria discovers the hidden magic of Oaxaca that boasts some of the finest ingredients in Mexico, including chocolate, corn, tomatoes and the much-loved quesillo cheese.
Exploring the vast Tibetan plateau, the home to a remarkable culture shaped by over 1,000 years of Buddhism and mountains and glaciers that provide a vital life support system for half the planet.

The teams are at the Old College, a part of Aberystwyth University on the West Coast of Wales. A grade-one listed building and the first University in Wales. Our experts Christina Trevanion and Raj Bisram are on hand to find a selection of objects to take to auction. Christina values a pair of Wedgwood plates, while a gold guinea impresses Raj. Paul Martin visits a Victorian tourist attraction that paved the way for modern photography.

Larry Dean, Kirsty Gallagher, Sam Quek and Lemn Sissay take on a series of quiz rounds selected by Richard Osman. A daily winner is declared following a quick-fire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week.

David Dickinson helps members of the public in Welwyn Garden City sort the treasures from their rubbish, offering them the chance to put items up for auction or accept a cash sum.
A rescue buoy from the set of Baywatch signed by David Hasselhoff and two flintlock blunderbuss pistols come into the shop. Rick and Corey check out a six-person solar bike.
A Civil War drum, an 1834 book with the original rules of baseball and a 1970s skateboard are brought into the shop.
Ursula gets fed up with Roy's antics at an auction in Old Weston, Toronto; Cindy gets more than she bargained for from her locker.
Paul and Bogart decide to tuck away their tricks and gimmicks for an auction held in Leaside; Roy gets to know Canadian metal icon Robb Reiner of Anvil.
Jesse and Papa Bear team up to bid on a safe protected by barbed wire, but what's inside? Brandon and Lori win a surfboard.
Lori goes behind Brandon's back as she teams up with Jesse to bid big. Papa Bear thinks there might be a shotgun hidden in one lot.

David and his dealers are in Winsford where Helen Gardiner discovers that clinching a deal for two rare German toys is far from child's play and Henry Nicholls gets a blast from the past from a retro phone.
David and his team including Corrie Jeffrey, James Layte, David Hakeney and Debbie Serpell are in Oldham today where a fascinating medal turns up on James's table.
David and dealers Michael Hogben, Brenda Haller, David Tupman and Simon Schneider find bargains hard to find in Oldham, but a mysterious pair of black glass jugs causes a stir in the room.
David and his dealers are in St Albas where Ian Towning is wooed by a Brazilian charmer for a retro clock and Karen Dalmeny finds herself losing her patience and cash over a stereoscope.
A James Brown suit comes into the shop, and Corey and Chum check out an artist proof from the film Anchors Aweigh.
Corey and Chum look at a water-propelled jetpack. Other valuable items that come into the shop are a promissory note from the Mexican-American War and a statue of the Hindu god Shiva.
Partnerships are tested in Brampton; Bogart puts Paul on a diet, and he complains about it; Cindy wants Rick to wear a new shirt that he doesn't like.

p.t: The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball
p.d: Nicole wants a new family portrait where everyone's entire face is in the photo and they're all smiling. Gumball must face his demons and overcome an embarrassing incident from his past if he wants to finally summit the dreaded rock-climbing wall.
A covert mission must be completed before cleaning the living room. / Mordecai gets freaked out by someone he used to babysit.
Finn and Jake must find a mate for a snail threatening to seize their home. A group of evil gnomes have kidnapped Finn to harness his boundless awesomeness.

The friends are disturbed by a strange amateur ornithologist who constantly spies on them; Robin receives a message from the winged warriors; Raven, Birdarang and he immediately go to the aid of their friends who are in danger.

When Darwin gets jealous of Gumball and Penny's relationship, he sets out to find information on Penny that will break them up. When Granny Jojo brings her new boyfriend to her birthday dinner, Dad bans her from seeing the boyfriend again.

Mr Bean seeks revenge on Bruiser Jr for his damaged toy aeroplane. As a part of his plan, Mr Bean buys a new plane, but his actions lead to unforeseen results. Mr Bean reminisces about his youth and a camping trip with Teddy.
What is a teen superhero's everyday life when the cape comes off? Robin, Starfire, Raven, Beast Boy and Cyborg deal with the usual issues of adolescence while trying to save the world.

Mr Bean takes on some unusual fraudsters. During a romantic evening, he has trouble. Mr Bean accidentally throws an angry tennis player's ball onto a roof. Attempting to remove a tooth becomes another challenge for him.

After the crew fishes out an ancient giant 20-sided dice, Lana discovers that she can alter reality every time she rolls it. The higher the number, the better, but this game of chance soon puts everyone's future in jeopardy.
When Kallista is forced to move into Gigi and Saige's dorm room, their natural antipathy spills over into an Emo Girl Punk Band!

Mordecai and Rigby want to help their friend Party Horse get back together with his girlfriend; after staying up for two straight nights watching a movie marathon, the guys attempt to get their sleep cycle back on track.

Gumball and Darwin have decided to do nothing for a whole day, but sometimes it's much harder to do nothing than something. The kids try to help Dad bond with Frankie. When the uncomfortableness between them reaches new levels, Gumball and Hot Dog Guy decide they have to confront their ongoing awkwardness by making things as awkward as possible. The kids realise that they've never known their neighbour's name, and they're way past the window where they can ask.
Jason must catch all the bank thieves in space and level 10 villains in the city. Just Jason and Drea attempt to save their favourite vehicle, before escaping Jason's arch nemesis.

When the heroes are faced with the Goblin King moving into the Big Birch, they decide to invent a quest that will soon have him running back home.

Two strange villains team up to stop Orli from making it to her Odd Squad UK exam so that she will fail and be sent back to Niagara Falls.

Steve Backshall meets the snappiest shark in the seas. The lemon shark scours the sandy seabed for food, but how does it get a good grip on hidden prey? Steve heads to the Bahamas in the Caribbean to dive with these feisty sharks.

Bradley Walsh hosts as Mike Bushell, Annabel Croft, Rhea Bailey, and Rylan Clark-Neal join forces in the hope that they have the knowledge to beat one of the country's finest quiz brains.
Nigel Havers hosts as five dealers bid against each other to buy items brought in by the public, including a Kentucky Derby fairground ride, antique dumbbells and a Dinky toy collection.

It's a time travelling episode of `Celebrity Antiques Road Trip' as the sixth Doctor Who, Colin Baker pairs up with Blue Peter stalwart, Peter Purves who played the first Doctor's assistant. The two will be exploring Herefordshire and Worcestershire in the TARDIS cunningly disguised as a 1970 Morris Minor, joined by experts Will Axon and James Braxton. They're armed with £400 to buy antiques that will make profit at auction, and on the way, Colin once again comes face-to-face with The Daleks.
Lily Savage hosts as contestants, with the help of a panel of celebrity guests, attempt to fill in the missing words of statements and phrases in order to beat the competition and win a prize.
Bradley Walsh presents the big money quiz based on his own idea which features six players who cannot leave the contest until somebody wins.
Ross Kemp presents as friends Yafai, Tony, Oliver and Alfie take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category.
Cat from Lanarkshire, Nathan from Llanelli, Lin from Kent and Mark from Manchester join forces in an attempt to take home thousands of pounds. Just one thing stands in their way, The Chaser.
Two of the three Goodies, Tim Brooke-Taylor and Graeme Garden, get back into character to take an antiques road trip around Devon.
Sara Cox and Jimmy Osmond face off against each other as they compete to win a big cash prize for their chosen charity, with a little help from their families.

Extrovert Jojo and long-term partner Adrian kick off the competition with their 1970s inspired menu. Day two sees young, fun-loving Mark and Zoe plan an international menu, and last to host are Caz and Dave with their Jewish-inspired family menu.
Colin Murray, Rachel Riley and Susie Dent host, with Marcus Brigstocke in Dictionary Corner, as contestants race against the clock to pit their wits against vowels, consonants and numbers.
Doug and Carrie start to believe in miracles after Carrie's prayers are answered, and Arthur decides to sell Doug and Carrie's house.
Out-of-shape Doug agrees to try out for a semi-professional American football league if Kirby will continue to play pee wee football.
Doug gets jealous of Carrie's gay co-worker; both Doug and Carrie worry about the strength of their marriage as they sign a 30-year mortgage plan.
Ray helps Ally obtain a Pokemon-style trading card, a 'Hackidu', which is all the rage with the kids in school.

Debra managed, against all expectations of her family, to conjure up an excellent menu on the table. Only Marie is not enthusiastic as she feels threatened in the kitchen. However, that doesn't diminish Debra's pride and joy.
Ray and Debra plan to get more time to themselves by getting Marie and Frank to make new friends, but all does not go to plan.

Frasier and Niles enjoy the comforts of Seattle's premier spa, receiving what they believe to be the best pampering in the city, but when they discover the exclusive locale also contains a 'Gold Level' area, which they aren't allowed into, they hatch a plan to wangle their way in. Then, they discover there's a 'Platinum Level'.
Frasier's anger and loose tongue land him in sexual harassment trouble with his hostile and arrogant new radio show partner, and Niles tries to treat patients from home.

Lilith pays an unexpected visit to Seattle and tells Frasier that she would like another child through artificial insemination. Meanwhile, Niles frets over Daphne, who has joined Roz, Alice and Mrs Moon on a road trip up to the frozen wastes of northern Canada.
Daphne's dinner party is nearly ruined when young Alice embellishes Niles' precious painting, so Frasier steps in to save the night.
Mike makes a big league offer on an ultra-rare vintage Edison invention, and a mega stash of beer-related memorabilia stokes Frank's Oktoberfest mojo.

Frasier and Niles enjoy the comforts of Seattle's premier spa, receiving what they believe to be the best pampering in the city, but when they discover the exclusive locale also contains a 'Gold Level' area, which they aren't allowed into, they hatch a plan to wangle their way in. Then, they discover there's a 'Platinum Level'.
Frasier's anger and loose tongue land him in sexual harassment trouble with his hostile and arrogant new radio show partner, and Niles tries to treat patients from home.

Lilith pays an unexpected visit to Seattle and tells Frasier that she would like another child through artificial insemination. Meanwhile, Niles frets over Daphne, who has joined Roz, Alice and Mrs Moon on a road trip up to the frozen wastes of northern Canada.
Daphne's dinner party is nearly ruined when young Alice embellishes Niles' precious painting, so Frasier steps in to save the night.
Mike makes a big league offer on an ultra-rare vintage Edison invention, and a mega stash of beer-related memorabilia stokes Frank's Oktoberfest mojo.
A special extended programme to mark Her Majesty Queen Elizabeth's funeral, from the state funeral service, to the procession through Westminster and then on to Windsor.

A daily round-up of showbiz news and gossip from around the world, focusing on celebrities, movies, music and entertainment.
The Mixmups go on an adventure to find a helper pet for Spin, but the chosen pet keeps hiding. The Mixmups work together to find another way to make the Booferoo come out and play.

It is school project time for Peppa and her friends, which means they have to build castles and bring them into playgroup. Mummy and Daddy Pig have lots of fun helping Peppa make hers, if only they could find the glitter.
When the police visit the school, officers Panda and Squirrel teach Peppa and her friends all about bicycle safety.
Tweedy learns that Fluffs do not like the wind.
Odo is thrilled to be spending the day looking after Eaglet's pet snail, Freddy. Odo has always wanted a pet and if he can prove he's a good snail-carer, maybe he can have his own pet.

When Gordon is late, the Fat Controller asks Henry to pull the Express. Despite his misgivings, he is a huge success. Meanwhile, Gordon is not happy that he has to take over Henry's work, which he thinks is beneath him, and decides to go on strike.
When Hannah uses her dad's JoeJet2000 to propel their hot air balloon, she loses control and needs the Ocean Rescue team to get them back to safety!

Mummy Pig's book is finished, and it's time to show it off to Peppa and her playgroup friends. Unfortunately, Peppa and George lose some of the book when they are playing, and Mummy Pig has to think quickly to fix it.
The friends are forming a band and Posy gives out roles to everyone except Mo, who feels left out. She must figure out how to properly include him.
Paddington learns that seagulls love chips and will do anything to get them.
Cap'n Turbot and his cousin Francois are observing a pair of mountain goats when a sudden avalanche strikes.
Rubble & Crew use their giant trucks to make awesome stunt ramps when Mega Meister challenges Mayor Greatway to a stunt competition.

Cleveland springt in seiner alten Highschool-Baseballmannschaft als Trainer ein und holt dafür extra sein altes Trikot aus dem Schrank. So will er auch seinen Sohn überzeugen, der Mannschaft beizutreten. Doch dieser ist lieber Teil der Mathematik-AG.

Mit einem satirischen Blick werden Nachrichten aus Politik, Kultur und der Medienwelt unterhaltsam präsentiert. Berühmte Gäste und Moderatoren arbeiten aktuelle Ereignisse humoristisch auf und kommentieren die politische Weltlage.

Kyle will mit seinem kleinen Bruder, namens Ike, Videospiele spielen, der hat aber keine Lust auf Kyle. Daraufhin fühlt sich Kyle verstoßen und hat Angst, dass er die nächste Generation nicht mehr versteht.
Die vier Freunde halten es für eine gute Idee, eine Firma zu gründen. Sie nennen das Start-up "The Washington Redskins". Natürlich ist das Chaos vorprogrammiert.

Bob und Linda treffen auf den in die Jahre gekommenen Star ihrer Lieblings-Samuraiserie aus den 70er-Jahren. Als sie jedoch erfahren, dass er kaum noch Kontakt zu seiner Tochter Chick hat, wollen sie die beiden wieder vereinen.

Bob und die anderen Mieter der Ocean Avenue organisieren einen Streik gegen die geplante Mieterhöhung. Schließlich bietet sich ihnen eine Gelegenheit, wie sie die Mieterhöhung abwenden können. Doch diese ist abseits der Norm.

Stan macht eine echte Bumerang-Erfahrung, als er Steve als Computer-Nerd bezeichnet, wenig später aber dank ihm einen gefährlichen Cyberterroristen festnehmen kann, der mit seinem PC regelmäßig wichtige Gebäude und Systeme zum Absturz bringt und damit jede Menge Schaden angerichtet hat. Roger zieht es derweil auf eine Science-Fiction Convention bei der er nicht nur Freunde treffen wird.

Als Stans angeblicher Vater davon scheidet, bekommt Stan heraus, dass sein wahrer Vater niemand Geringeres als der Superagent Jack Smith ist. Jack versucht seinen angeblichen Sohn davon zu überzeugen, aus der CIA auszutreten und seiner ultrageheimen "Scarlet Alliance" Spionagegruppe beizutreten.
Barbara erfährt, dass Tariq mit der Mutter einer Schülerin seiner Klasse zusammen ist.

Der Unterricht bei Chris' neuer Literaturlehrerin Miss Rivera ist hoffnungslos langweilig - und die Aufgabe, eine Buchrezension über den Roman "Der unsichtbare Mann" von Ralph Ellison zu schreiben, trägt nicht gerade zur Besserung von Chris' Laune bei. Um die lästige Pflicht zu umgehen, kommt Chris auf die Idee, sich einfach die dazugehörige Literaturverfilmung anzusehen. Leider merkt er zu spät, dass die Kinofassung so gar nichts mit der eigentlichen Romanvorlage zu tun hat.

Krise bei Mikes Baseballteam "Die Monsterprügel": Die Gemeinde stellt der Mannschaft die Wiese nur zur Verfügung, wenn die Jungs ein gemischtes Team stellen. Mandy müht sich mit ihrer Bewerbung für das College ab. Kristin geht ihr zur Hand und stellt dabei auch die Weichen für die eigene Zukunft.

Gegen Vanessas Willen möchte Mandy unbedingt bei "America's Top-Teen-Model" mitmachen. Dafür nimmt Mandy per Selbstauslöser äußerst freizügige Fotos auf. Als Mike die Bilder sieht, macht er sich Sorgen.

Kurz vor der Geburt des Babys bekommt Lois ungebetenen, nervtötenden Besuch von ihrer Großmutter Ida. Lois heckt einen Plan aus, um die Frau wieder loszuwerden, doch gerade dann platzt ihre Fruchtblase.

Lois' Wehen haben eingesetzt, doch die Sanitäter wollen einfach nicht kommen. Unterdessen muss Lois sich mit ihrer gemeinen Mutter und Craigs idiotischen Tipps zum Thema Geburt beschäftigen. Francis eilt zur Hilfe.
Die Nachbarn Henry und Margaret Farnsby schlittern in eine Ehekrise. Auslöser dafür ist Sam.

It's Valentine's Day and, out on his first date in nine years, Ross meets up with his ex-wife. Meanwhile, Monica, Phoebe and Rachel rebel against the spirit of the day by burning mementos of past relationships.
Phoebe doesn't get on with her identical twin Ursula. Unfortunately, no one can tell them apart, which leads to a few cases of mistaken identity, not least for Joey who is quite taken with Ursula.

When the body of a man is found hanging from a tree with his arms bound and FED scrawled on his chest, Kentucky State Police and the FBI must unravel a complicated mystery. Was this a vicious act of targeted retribution, or something else entirely?
After a 69-year-old woman is found dead in her bathtub, a suspect leads detectives from Tulsa, Oklahoma, on a high-speed chase that ends tragically.
Joe Kenda's wife grapples with the terrifying reality of being married to a cop, when she hears her husband shot down over the phone.

After an infant stops breathing, Kenda and Walker investigate whether the daycare is to blame or the parents themselves; Kenda works an execution-style shooting, and he is shocked to learn the victim is a kindly grandmother.

It's the Fourth of July at the Lake of the Ozarks and the fireworks aren't just in the sky as officers from all three police departments respond to holiday reckless revellers on the road and in the bars.
A desperate woman needs to poop during a traffic stop, a mum is busted sneaking into a school dressed as her daughter, a man jumps into a store's 24,000 gallon aquarium, and more.
A convicted quadruple murderer argues with the judge; a pastor who stole from his church hears from his congregation; a man who murdered his grandparents becomes disorderly in the courtroom.
Emilia uncovers details surrounding Joshua Stimpson's murder of ex-girlfriend Molly McLaren, a case which shook the victim's family and community to its core.
Emilia looks into the killing of Martin Decker, who had been bludgeoned with a hammer. Police would link the murder to a suspect dubbed the NR3 cat killer.
Emilia uncovers details surrounding the brutal murder of Rosie Darbyshire. Witnesses and CCTV were key to solving the case that shocked the local community.

A prominent booster with ties all the way to the top of 'Bama football suffers a fall from grace. But as he fights to clear his name, his naked dead body is found by his housekeeper in a bloody scene that appears to be a violent murder.

In the quiet town of Greenville, South Carolina, the Johns family is struck by an unimaginable tragedy. Jacob Johns walks into the flat he shared with his twin brother, Jared, to find Jared's lifeless body and a gun beside him.

Tisha Raines believed she had finally found love, but discovers she has fallen victim to a romance scam. Consumed by feelings of betrayal and anger, Raines seeks revenge, but her actions take an even darker turn.

Rick visits Bologna in northern Italy, a city so famous for its food that it is known as the stomach of Italy. He learns how to make the local fresh egg pasta used for tortellini, tagliatelle, ravioli and lasagne.

Rick Stein visits Lisbon on the banks of the River Tagus, a city in love with its seafood and possibly the best custard tarts in the world. The culinary effects of Portugal's historic explorations are still seen in its dishes with hints of cinnamon and freshly chopped coriander from the east, and tomatoes and chillies from the Americas.

Freddie, Chris and Paddy head to the Lake District for an emotional reunion with their own dads' old cars. Elsewhere, Chris heads out on track to test Lamborghini's most powerful car ever: the hybrid Sian.

The team try out some of James Bond's greatest cars, including the legendary Aston Martin DB5. Freddie and an Extreme E race car take on a man with a jetpack, while Chris and Paddy test a new Ferrari against a very old Alfa.

Paul and Bob are fishing for tench, a fish they have not targeted since the first series. They arrive at Rocklands Mere, a secluded hidden gem in the quaint village of Rocklands St Peter, and settle down to fish.
Guy visits Llandudno to help get this Queen of Victorian resorts up to scratch in time for the summer season. The great British seaside holiday was a largely Victorian invention.

Whether savoury or sweet, the British love puddings. Dave and Si create some classic puds and explore the history and traditions behind our favourites. There is no point in counting calories with delicious puds, but the bikers do try and burn some off when they take part in the world black-pudding throwing competition in Lancashire.

Matthew reist zu dem Bauernhof von Andreas in der Eifel, doch die Wetterbedingungen sagen ihm dort überhaupt nicht zu. Er macht sich auf den Weg zurück nach Australien, um neben der Goldsuche dort eine Waschanlage zu eröffnen.

Der Fund zweier Nuggets sorgt dafür, dass Mat seine Rechnungen in Australien begleichen kann. Doch leider hält das Glück nicht lange ein und er gerät in einen Verkehrsunfall. Derweil plant Andreas, seinen Maschinenpark zu erweitern.

p.t: Fang des Lebens - Der gefährlichste Job Alaskas
p.d: In der Beringsee herrschen minus 39 Grad Außentemperatur: Kapitän Sig Hansen und seiner Crew bläst auf der Northwestern ein eisiger Nordwind ins Gesicht. In diesem Winter sind die Bedingungen am nördlichsten Ende des Pazifischen Ozeans besonders extrem. Doch von solchen Widrigkeiten dürfen sich die Krabbenfischer nicht aufhalten lassen, denn sie müssen ihre Fangkörbe vor dem Packeis retten.

p.t: Fang des Lebens - Der gefährlichste Job Alaskas
p.d: Das Ende der Schneekrabbensaison ist in Sicht. Den Krabbenfischern bleiben nur noch drei Wochen Zeit, um ihre Fangquoten zu erfüllen. Die Kapitäne treiben ihre Besatzungen deshalb zu Höchstleistungen an. Diesem mörderischen Arbeitstempo sind nicht alle Seeleute gewachsen. Greenhorn Robby Schlosstein hat in der letzten Schicht insgesamt 200 Fangkörbe beködert und kann vor Schmerzen kaum noch seine Hände bewegen.

p.t: Border Control: Türkei - Grenzschützer im Einsatz
p.d: Der Zoll kontrolliert in dieser Folge am Hafen von Ambarlı zwei Container mit Massagesesseln aus China. In den Großraumbehältern befinden sich zwei verschiedene Modelle.

Bei einer Kontrolle wurde in einem Lkw eine Cannabis-Mühle entdeckt. An einem Flughafen haben zwei Männer Shisha-Tabak in einem Teppich versteckt. In den Post-Terminals wurden in einem Paket drei Armbrüste, deklariert als Sportzubehör, gefunden.

Vater und Sohn benötigen kurzfristig Cash für die Urlaubskasse. Deshalb möchte das Duo Schmuck und einen E-Scooter beleihen, den Nikolaus Bode in Siegburg persönlich testet. In Dresden wechselt das Bargeld in die andere Richtung über die Ladentheke.

The week begins at the Old Rose and Crown in Birmingham, where hosts Andrew and Jo hope their 30 years of experience will put them on the throne at week's end. Problems with paintwork and missing milk leave them with some meaty feedback to chew over.

The second visit of the week is to Middlewick in Glastonbury, run by Jill and Inez, who hope that their mystical location will enchant their guests. The guests are confounded by a cottage next to a camping pod, and the avocado breakfast offering.

At The Griffin Inn in Lincolnshire, hosts Jamie and Leila invite the guests to their very own village, steeped in family history. Guest Jo dishes the dirt on Jamie's decorating, and damp patches are a problem.

The final visit is to Crossroads House in Carlisle, owned by Julie and Alistair Musgrave, who pride themselves on their full English fry-up. The guests note the B&B's roadside location and mismatched decor, and Julie lacks confidence in the kitchen.

It's feedback time as the B&Bers discuss lukewarm reactions to the facilities, paying for breakfast, and picky comments about paintwork. Harsh truths are aired before the payments are revealed, and the winner is announced.
First up in East Cheshire is fun and flirty Val Slater. The glamorous pensioner is out to impress with a Middle Eastern banquet.
Yummy mummy Hazel Ardern is hoping her combination of fine food and great hosting skills will get her top scores in east Cheshire.
Radio DJ Nick Hawkins hosts in East Cheshire and his guests are surprised by his choice of menu. Val and Hazel doubt whether he can get his beef Wellington to rise to the occasion.
It's the turn of garage servicing manager and motor-mouth Michelle Kenworthy to host in East Cheshire.
Last to host in East Cheshire is party girl Zoe Miller, who is out to win and also grab the limelight, and she's showing off with her menu which represents all her favourite countries.
This competition starts at The Old Stables, Somerset, where Finnish-born Nina Dodd and husband Andy welcome guests to their Scandinavian-style accommodation.
Morris Cockman runs Rigsby's Guest House in Hertford. Morris's tattoos have previously raised eyebrows, while his attempt to entertain his guests at a local zoo isn't a hit with everyone.
David and Erica Hensley are the owners of The Fairway in Blackpool. The couple bring some classic Blackpool fun to the mix as the group take on some local zombies in a horror walk.
Robin Hughes runs the converted Dent Station in the Yorkshire Dales. Robin organises a butchery competition and high-end grub nearby, where a few home truths about the group dynamic are revealed.

Loner Dan Measey needs money quickly and gambles on new, untested AI technology to detect opal. Slim Pickings has to move.

Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life. Loona Hazarika from London is first to arrive with an Indian dancing doll that he'd love ceramics expert Kirsten Ramsay and clockwork king Steve Fletcher to work on. The figurine comes in four fragile pieces connected together with wires, when touched she gives a little wiggle.

Henry and Fuzz pay Derby a visit where they meet with bike enthusiast Marc. Checking out his shed, the pair stumble upon a classic Raleigh Runabout. But have they bitten off more than they can chew with this vintage bike?

A Honda CB400F in Gary's shed in Rotherham proves irresistible to Henry and Fuzz. Henry jumps at the chance to work on the beloved gem but Fuzz is aware that they'll need to work hard to make the bike ready for sale. Can the team get the job done?
While visiting Joe's shed, Henry and Fuzz find an impressive 1950s Green Goddess Fire Engine. But have they bitten off more than they can chew?

p.t: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
p.d: The boys are in and around Herefordshire and Worcestershire. Henry makes a table from the base of a broken agricultural grain mill while Simon creates a garden seat from an old mangle.
A widow needs help to clear her late husband's collection of militaria. Plus, a couple hope a Chinese warlord will fund a much-needed holiday.

p.d: Consultant Brandon must find a dress to flatter one bride's non-traditional wedding party, including her drag queen 'Bridesman' Baybay. Can they find a style to suit them all?

p.d: Nicole wants green and purple dresses for her winery wedding, but will her bridesmaids agree? Plus it's a battle between denim and chiffon for one bride and her stubborn sister.

p.t: Say Yes to the Dress: Bridesmaids
p.d: Lori's team seeks out the perfect dress for an insecure bridesmaid with serious body image issues. Meanwhile, bride Emily's insulting outbursts threaten to spoil her friendships.

p.t: Say Yes to the Dress: Bridesmaids
p.d: A bride's controlling mother tries to tell her what dress to wear; a military bride has a battle over sexy dresses; a scientific bride chooses red dresses for her beach wedding.
A bride and groom from Big Brother shop together, social media pro Kristin must look perfect, and Chef Cat Cora gets married!
In the first case, CCTV footage captures a brutal stabbing outside a shopping centre in Grimsby. Then, a teenager makes the decision to become a prison pen pal to a convicted killer.
An ex-footballer abducted, raped and murdered two university students five years apart. Investigating the steps that led to these sinister murders.

p.t: On the Case With Paula Zahn
p.d: A woman finds a young mother murdered following a festive New Year's celebration.

A family's worst nightmare begins when 23-year-old Christina Morris goes missing while out with friends in Plano, Texas. Police franticly search to find her alive, but the discovery of surveillance camera footage reveals the shocking truth.
A fisherman's illegal catch provides a feast for Hope's patients, and an invasive species also winds up on the menu.

Ireland is small but epic in wonder. Surrounded by the Atlantic Ocean, from the Cliffs of Moher to the extraordinary Giant's Causeway, this land has been shaped and reshaped by both the power of water and violent geological forces.
Alison and Jeremy are travelling to Wales to collect monkeys from a zoo; The monkey team is preparing for their arrival.

The global pandemic continues to cause tension at the park as the staff are required to isolate. Macaque Sylvie is off her food and rapidly losing weight, so local vet Dave Harding is called to examine her.
Surviving in the African savanna requires wit and guile. Especially for two of its hunters: African wild dogs and Dwarf mongooses.
A fawn survives a snare and a bobcat attack. A baby bobcat winds up on Hope's doorstep, and an old friend returns to the rehab.

Tracking scientists who have arrived in the Kalahari to test a hypothesis: animal collaboration is the key to the dizzying diversity of the region's species. Observing as they monitor behaviour, decipher data and deliver fascinating conclusions.
On the heights of the Tibetan plateau, large expanses are traversed by vast herds of kiangs, the largest known breed of wild ass in the world, but human intervention threatens their ecosystem.

Artemio idea un plan para sacar a Liliana de la ciudad. Bárbara le asegura a Camilo que no planea quedarse con la fortuna de Gonzalo. Priscila lleva a cabo sus planes para alejar a Vladímir de su familia.

p.t: La ley y el orden: Crimen organizado
p.d: Stabler y el oficial Bashir localizan a un padre y a su hijo desaparecidos que podrían darles las respuestas que necesitan. Después de que una operación encubierta sale mal, Bell reasigna a Reyes a tareas administrativas. Stabler se reencuentra con su hermano menor.
Alguien está enviando explosivos a representantes de los medios de comunicación. El equipo pide ayuda para examinar los objetos y evitar un nuevo atentado.
Un niño baleado en su vecindario obliga a Cruz y su hermano a pensar en la pandilla. Isabella logra que Mills se vista para una fiesta de gala. Casey se siente triste porque verá menos a Dawson.

Boden intenta evitar que la estación de bomberos sea cerrada. Se produce un romance entre Dawson y Casey. Cruz se preocupa por la seguridad de su hermano. Severide y Katie recuperan el tiempo perdido.

El jefe Boden encabeza la pelea para mantener abierta la estación de bomberos; una llamada de emergencia a unos departamentos pone al equipo en el camino del peligro; Dawson recibe noticias que cambian su vida.
La investigación de una cadena de robos a inmigrantes vulnerables se intensifica cuando una adolescente es secuestrada por los ladrones.

El padre del doctor Halstead es admitido en el hospital, pese a que él no quería. El doctor Charles toma medidas cuando su hija empieza a comportarse de manera todavía más extraña. La doctora Manning siente el agobio de trabajar y ser madre.

Una mujer desesperada por ayudar a su hija a combatir el cáncer. El Dr. Charles sugiere a Sarah conducir la evaluación psiquiátrica de su hija Robin. El Dr. Choi presiona a Noah cuando un puesto para residencia se libera.

p.t: La ley y el orden: Unidad de Víctimas Especiales
p.d: Cuando los detectives investigan denuncias de abusos sexuales en una escuela privada de élite, décadas de secretos son expuestos.

p.t: La ley y el orden: Unidad de Víctimas Especiales
p.d: Un hombre protagoniza una matanza, pero él está relacionado con una prostituta que Benson conoció en una investigación previa, por lo que el FBI contacta a UVE por información.

El Dr. Rhodes desafía al Dr. Charles y a otro colega del hospital sobre el tratamiento para Robin. El Dr. Manning busca ayuda del detective Halstead cuando un caso que involucra a una joven se convierte en un crimen. Goodwin ayuda a un amigo.

Halstead y Manning colaboran para emitir un diagnóstico sobre el estado de salud de un refugiado sirio que llegó sin informes médicos. Llega un nuevo y atrevido doctor al hospital. Readmiten a Robin en el hospital. Noah organiza una fiesta.

Casey regresa a trabajar después de un roce con la muerte. El nuevo compañero de Shay es amigable con todos menos con ella. Dawson empieza a entrenar. Severide se prepara para su tarea como instructor. Clarke rechaza hablar con la policía.

Casey intenta convencer a todos de que él está saludable. Shay evita al abogado que quiere hablar acerca del suicidio de Daryl. Otis y Katie se acercan. Boden ayuda a una mujer con un propietario negligente.

Una serie de fenómenos inexplicables empiezan a desencadenarse después del descarrilamiento de un tren, lo que hace sospechar a varios cineastas jóvenes, quienes fueron testigos del hecho, que la catástrofe no fue un accidente.

Víctor percibe con horror que su hija, Ángela, y la amiga de esta, Katherine, muestran síntomas de haber sido poseídas por una entidad demoníaca. Desesperado, busca la ayuda de Chris MacNeil, la única persona viva que ha experimentado algo así.

Cuatro sagaces inversores intentan sacar provecho de la crisis económica que comenzó en el año 2008, pero sus inversiones de riesgo les acaban conduciendo al lado más tenebroso de la economía, donde nadie es quien parece.

Cuando los tesoros más grandes del mundo, incluido el diamante de la Pantera Rosa, son robados, solamente un hombre puede resolver el misterio: Clouseau. Junto con su compañero Ponton y un equipo de detectives internacionales, el inepto detective debe atrapar al ladrón y recuperar los artefactos, sin provocar muchos daños colaterales en el proceso.
El detrás de cámaras de "Dunkirk", "Atómica" y "Annabelle 2: La creación del mal".
Imágenes del rodaje de "Adiós, Christopher Robin", "Feliz cumpleaños" y "Todos somos iguales".

Dos pasajeros que viajan en hibernación a un planeta lejano despiertan, por un error técnico, 90 años antes de llegar a destino. Solos y rodeados de lujos, entre ellos surge el amor; sin embargo, descubren que hay una avería en la nave y tendrán que repararla a tiempo para salvar a las 5000 personas que permanecen hibernando, y a sí mismos.

Un hombre agradable e inseguro se ve obligado a competir por el cariño de los hijos de su esposa con el padre de los chicos cuando este regresa a la ciudad. Sus personalidades no podrían ser más diferentes: el padrastro es afable, el padre rebelde.

Dora se pone al frente de un equipo formado por su amigo peludo Botas; Diego, un misterioso habitante de la jungla; y un desorganizado grupo de adolescentes para salvar a los padres de Dora y resolver el misterio de una ciudad perdida de oro.

Sonic intenta atravesar las complejidades de la vida en la Tierra con su nuevo mejor amigo, un humano llamado Tom Wachowski. Deberán unir sus fuerzas para evitar que el malvado Dr. Robotnik capture a Sonic y use sus poderes para dominar el mundo.
Sonic y su compañero Tails emprenden un viaje alrededor del mundo en busca de una esmeralda que tiene el poder de destruir civilizaciones.
Una mujer de Colorado desaparece poco después de mudarse con un grupo de amigos. Una investigación revela que sucedía mucho más dentro de la casa de lo que nadie se había dado cuenta.

Una aspirante a escritora y pintora en la vibrante escena artística del Soho de principios de los 80 es asesinada, solo dos días después de la publicación de su primer libro. Su esposo devastado por el crimen comparte una pista importantísima.

Después de que una mujer es encontrada muerta a tiros con su hija de 9 meses en la habitación de al lado, los detectives descubren una red de encuentros nocturnos, amantes secretos y celos enfermizos.
Una mujer es hallada acuchillada en su apartamento. Con una larga lista de admiradores, los investigadores descubren obsesiones secretas que conducen a un asesino sádico inesperado.

Una parada rutinaria hecha por la policía de tráfico desenmascara, para sorpresa de los agentes, a dos mujeres criminales.
Dos amantes conspiran para cometer un asesinato y después hacerse con una gran suma de dinero cobrando el seguro de vida.
En vísperas de Navidad en un pueblo silencioso, Bob e Idella Young son brutalmente asesinados en su casa; encuentran un guante ensangrentado en la escena del crimen que tiene el ADN del asesino.

Dos detectives descubren que Tim Wicks vive en dos comunidades diferentes, pero no reconocen cuál es el Tim real y cuál está mintiendo. Además, los investigadores obtienen evidencia de malversación y fraude que conduce a un asesinato.
Mentiras, decepción y un triángulo amoroso provocaron la muerte de un millonario norteamericano en la carretera de México.

Joanna y Carl Dutcher anuncian la llegada del Año Nuevo con su nieto. Días después, sus cadáveres son hallados; la búsqueda del asesino conduce a la policía a un grupo siniestro que amenaza a toda la comunidad.

Una madre soltera que está embarazada de su segundo hijo le da las buenas noches a su hija de 12 años en su casa de Brooklyn a la medianoche. A la mañana siguiente, la encuentran muerta en el río Hudson, en el centro de Manhattan.

p.t: The Real Murders of Orange County
p.d: Una joven sale una noche con sus amigos y nunca regresa a casa. Un caso desconcertante que se mantuvo frío durante nueve años, hasta que una confesión impactante abre el caso de nuevo y expone la pieza que falta.
Edmond localiza a Gastón, el hijo ilegítimo de Villefort, que se ha convertido en ladrón. Danglars descubre las traiciones de Fernand en Argelia y lo revela todo a la prensa.

El grupo terrorista Voltov secuestra a la microbióloga Rachel Moss y la obliga a crear un arma biológica letal. Zara y Vincent ven cómo su misión rutinaria de vigilancia en Bengasi se convierte en una carrera contrarreloj para impedir la propagación del virus antes de que provoque consecuencias devastadoras a nivel mundial.

Un ataque brutal impide que Zara recopile información crucial en Londres. Ella se da cuenta de que alguien dentro del MI6 está filtrando información a Voltov. En Bengasi, Vincent y Rachel son tomados como rehenes por Voltov, y Vincent le promete a Rachel que la ayudará a escapar.

Susan investiga la casa de un cliente, embrujada por un joven soldado de la era de Vietnam cuya guerra nunca terminó.

Después de enterarse de la muerte de su padre, House es obligado a asistir al funeral. El equipo intenta diagnosticar la enfermedad de una joven adoptada que sufrió un colapso mientras estaba en China buscando a sus padres biológicos.

Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.
